note: Both sets read a stacked bar chart and repeatedly bind total bar heights to the glass_biax segment (e.g. 38/42/32/28/22/18 mm), which are wrong since glass_biax is only the thin top segment (~1-5 mm). Set A adds three grossly misbound CarbonUD claims (13, 18 and 37 mm) where CarbonUD is only a thin sliver, plus three self-contradictory duplicate values for the same web/position/layer. Set B keeps the medium_density_foam series largely consistent with the large gray segments across positions and has fewer total-height misbindings and fewer internal contradictions. Neither set captures the small gelcoat/glass_triax/glass_uni layers, and both include trivial zero-thickness claims.
